hero.description: A free password manager for teams and individuals. Share passwords securely anywhere with GPG encryption and Git sync.

features.title: Features
features.description: PassShare is fully compatible with pass/gopass. Get more powerful features without breaking your existing workflow.

gpgEncryption.title: GPG/Age Encryption
gpgEncryption.description: Protect your passwords with industry-standard encryption. Use your existing GPG keys as-is.

gitSync.title: Git Sync
gitSync.description: Automatic version control and sync across multiple devices. Full change history tracking.

teamSharing.title: Team Sharing
teamSharing.description: Support for multiple recipients. Securely share passwords among team members.

gopassCompat.title: gopass Compatible
gopassCompat.description: Use your existing pass/gopass store as-is. Zero migration cost.

cliApi.title: CLI & API
cliApi.description: Both command-line and programmatic API support. Perfect for automation.

multiLangSdk.title: Multi-language SDK
multiLangSdk.description: SDKs available in 3 languages: Python, TypeScript, and Node.js.

performance.title: High Performance
performance.description: Fast operation even with 1000+ secrets. Efficient design.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-Platform
crossPlatform.description: Supports Linux, macOS, and Windows. Same experience everywhere.

migration.title: Easy Migration
migration.description: Migrate from other password managers with just one click

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: Compare PassShare with other password managers

step2.title: Check GPG Key
step2.hint: No GPG key? Create one with: gpg --full-generate-key

step3.title: Initialize Store
step3.hint: You can also use email: passshare init you@example.com

step4.title: Add Password
step4.hint: You'll be prompted to enter a password

done.title: 🎉 Setup Complete!
done.description: Next: Use passshare generate to create secure passwords automatically

cta.title: Get Started Now
cta.description: PassShare is completely free. Use your existing pass/gopass store as-is.
